components.name: ATmega328P 8-Bit AVR Microcontroller
components.description: High-performance, low-power Microchip 8-bit AVR RISC-based microcontroller combining 32 KB ISP flash memory with read-while-write capabilities, 1 KB EEPROM, 2 KB SRAM, 23 general-purpose I/O lines, 32 general-purpose working registers, and 3 flexible timer/counters.

components.name: ATmega16U2 USB-to-UART Bridge Controller
components.description: Dedicated AVR microcontroller featuring full-speed USB 2.0 device hardware and pre-programmed USB-to-Serial CDC firmware, bridging USB packets from host PC to ATmega328P hardware UART.

components.name: NCP1117 5.0V Low-Dropout Linear Voltage Regulator
components.description: Positive low-dropout linear regulator providing up to 1.0A output current. Regulates external DC barrel jack power (7V-12V) down to clean 5.0V for MCU and peripherals.

components.name: LP2985 3.3V Ultra-Low-Dropout Linear Regulator
components.description: Precision fixed-voltage 3.3V regulator supplying up to 150 mA for 3.3V sensors, displays, and external low-voltage microchips.

components.name: 16.000 MHz Quartz Crystal Oscillator
components.description: High-stability quartz crystal resonator paired with dual 22pF ceramic load capacitors to drive the primary XTAL1/XTAL2 oscillator circuit of ATmega328P.

components.name: 16.000 MHz SMD Ceramic Resonator
components.description: Compact 3-terminal piezoelectric ceramic resonator with integrated load capacitors driving the ATmega16U2 USB transceiver clock.

components.name: USB Type-B Female Receptacle (Through-Hole)
components.description: Heavy-duty industrial USB Type-B port providing reliable 5V USB bus power and differential D+/D- serial communications.

components.name: DC Power Barrel Jack 2.1mm x 5.5mm
components.description: Standard 2.1mm center-positive barrel connector for external DC power adapters ranging from 7V to 12V.

components.name: Tactile Reset Pushbutton Switch
components.description: Normally-open momentary tactile pushbutton connecting ATmega328P Pin 1 (/RESET) to ground, forcing MCU hardware reset.

components.name: 10-Pin Female Header Strip (Digital 8-13, GND, AREF, SDA, SCL)
components.description: Upper digital header row exposing SPI lines (D10-D13), internal LED (D13), analog reference (AREF), ground, and secondary duplicate I2C pins (SDA, SCL).

components.name: 8-Pin Female Header Strip (Digital 0-7, UART RX/TX, PWM)
components.description: Digital header row exposing Hardware Serial (D0 RX, D1 TX), External Interrupts (D2, D3), and PWM channels (D3, D5, D6).

components.name: 8-Pin Female Header Strip (Power & System Reset)
components.description: Power delivery header providing IOREF (5V), RESET, 3.3V (150mA max), 5.0V (regulated or USB bus), dual GND pins, and raw VIN (7-12V).

components.name: 6-Pin Female Header Strip (Analog Inputs A0 - A5)
components.description: Analog input header connected to ATmega328P internal 10-bit Successive Approximation ADC multiplexer. A4/A5 also serve as primary hardware I2C bus (SDA/SCL).

components.name: 2x3 In-Circuit Serial Programming (ICSP) Header
components.description: Direct AVR SPI hardware programming header for burning Optiboot bootloader or firmware directly into ATmega328P flash memory via Atmel-ICE or USBasp programmer.

components.name: 2x3 ICSP Header for ATmega16U2
components.description: Secondary 6-pin ICSP header positioned near USB-B port for flashing custom USB DFU firmware or MIDI/HID controller code onto ATmega16U2.

components.name: 100uF 25V Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitor
components.description: Bulk input smoothing capacitor filtering low-frequency AC ripple and input voltage transients from external DC barrel jack power.

components.name: 47uF 25V Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitor
components.description: Output reservoir capacitor stabilizing the 5.0V power rail, suppressing voltage dips when switching loads or wireless modules.

components.name: 100nF (0.1uF) 50V Ceramic Decoupling Capacitor
components.description: High-frequency decoupling capacitor placed in immediate proximity to IC power pins to shunt digital switching noise to ground.

components.name: 22pF 50V Ceramic Crystal Load Capacitor
components.description: Ultra-stable C0G dielectric load capacitor matched to the 16MHz crystal resonant loop.

components.name: 1.0 kΩ 1% Thick Film SMD Resistor
components.description: Current-limiting resistor for onboard status LEDs (L, TX, RX) and protection lines.

components.name: 10 kΩ 1% SMD Pullup Resistor
components.description: Standard pullup resistor holding ATmega328P Pin 1 (/RESET) firmly at 5.0V during normal operation.

components.name: 4x 1kΩ Isolated Resistor Network (CAY16)
components.description: Integrated quad-resistor network providing matched series protection resistors for UART communication and status LED lines.

components.name: Yellow 0805 SMD LED (Pin 13 "L" Indicator)
components.description: Onboard user test LED driven by ATmega328P Digital Pin 13 through an LMV358 dual operational amplifier buffer stage.

components.name: Green 0805 SMD LED ("ON" Power Indicator)
components.description: Permanent green power status LED wired across the 5.0V rail and GND through a 1kΩ current-limiting resistor.

components.name: Yellow 0805 SMD LED ("TX" Transmit Indicator)
components.description: Flashes yellow whenever ATmega16U2 transmits serial data packets to the host computer over USB.

components.name: Yellow 0805 SMD LED ("RX" Receive Indicator)
components.description: Flashes yellow whenever host computer sends serial data packets to the Uno over USB.

components.name: SS14 1.0A 40V Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier
components.description: Fast-recovery low-forward-drop Schottky diode placed in series with the DC barrel jack input to protect board circuitry against inverted DC polarity.

components.name: 500mA Resettable PTC Polyfuse (MF-MSMF050)
components.description: Overcurrent protection device positioned between the USB-B connector 5V pin and the board power rail. Trips automatically if peripheral current exceeds 500mA.

components.name: LMV358 Dual Rail-to-Rail Low-Voltage Operational Amplifier
components.description: Dual rail-to-rail operational amplifier performing two vital tasks: Channel A serves as an auto-switching voltage comparator toggling between USB power and DC barrel power, and Channel B acts as a high-impedance buffer driving the Pin 13 "L" LED without loading the microcontroller GPIO.

components.name: 28-Pin Dual-In-Line (DIP) IC Socket
components.package: DIP-28 Through-Hole 0.1" Pin Pitch x 0.3" Row Spacing
components.description: Precision machined dual-contact socket allowing tool-less replacement of the ATmega328P microcontroller chip in the event of an electrical failure.
